requirement_text: 2026-2027 Academic Year Application Conditions to Undergraduate Programs for International Students
researcher_notes: Page heading, establishing the cycle these conditions govern. Sabancı is the only Turkish university in this corpus whose international-admissions page is explicitly bound to a named academic year.

requirement_text: According to the latest announcement made by the Council of Higher Education (YÖK), applicants must meet the following conditions for the 2026 international student admission quotas:
researcher_notes: CRITICAL FRAMING: these eligibility rules originate with YÖK, Türkiye's national higher-education regulator, NOT with Sabancı. They therefore apply across Turkish universities generally, and the same text should be expected on Koç, Boğaziçi, Bilkent, METU and Özyeğin pages. Modelling this as a Sabancı-specific requirement would duplicate a national rule across every Turkish institution.

requirement_text: International students provided that they are not currently enrolled in or graduates of secondary education (high school) institutions in Türkiye (except who enroll Embassy Schools and International Private Education Institutions in the MOBIS system and who has been brought to our country within the framework of the project conducted by the Ministry of National Education)
researcher_notes: The base eligibility rule. Note it is defined by WHERE the student went to high school, not by nationality alone. Listed under the ELIGIBLE conditions.

requirement_text: Those holding Turkish citizenship by birth who renounced their Turkish citizenship, and their children under 18 who are listed in the renouncement document but documenting their certification for rights mentioned in the Turkish Citizenship Law
researcher_notes: Blue Card holders. Still conditional on not having attended high school in Türkiye or the TRNC. Listed under the ELIGIBLE conditions.

requirement_text: Those who hold citizenship of other countries by birth and have gained citizenship of The Republic of Turkey, / those who hold dual-citizenship
researcher_notes: Conditional on not being enrolled in or a graduate of a high school in Türkiye or the TRNC. Listed under the ELIGIBLE conditions.

requirement_text: Those who hold the citizenship of The Republic of Turkey and have completed their entire high school education in another country except The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
researcher_notes: DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO ORYN'S CORE USER: a Turkish citizen who did their whole high school abroad CAN apply on the international quota. 'Entire' is doing real work - a partial year in Türkiye breaks eligibility. Listed under the ELIGIBLE conditions.

requirement_text: Those who hold the citizenship of The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, who reside in The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus and who have completed their secondary education in a GCE AL system, as well as those who have registered and completed their secondary education in a GCE AL system abroad between 2005-2010
researcher_notes: TRNC route, gated on the GCE A-Level system specifically. Listed under the ELIGIBLE conditions.

requirement_text: Who hold the citizenship of The Republic of Turkey, and have completed their secondary education in Turkey or in The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
limitations: This is an EXCLUSION. Storing it alongside positive requirements without an is_exclusion marker would invert its meaning - a student matching this text is disqualified, not qualified.
researcher_notes: The main exclusion. A Turkish student educated in Türkiye must go through YKS/ÖSYM, not the international quota. Listed under the CANNOT APPLY conditions.

requirement_text: Dual nationals whose first nationality by birth is the Republic of Türkiye, as defined in subparagraph (2) of clause (a) (excluding those who meet the conditions specified in subparagraph (4) of clause (a))
limitations: This is an EXCLUSION. Storing it alongside positive requirements without an is_exclusion marker would invert its meaning - a student matching this text is disqualified, not qualified.
researcher_notes: An exclusion that carries its own cross-referenced exception. Cannot be evaluated as a flat boolean - the exception depends on another clause of the same rule. Listed under the CANNOT APPLY conditions.

requirement_text: Those who hold citizenship of The Republic of Turkey or dual citizenship, one of which is the citizenship of The Republic of Turkey by birth, ... and who have completed their secondary education at institutions within an embassy or in other foreign institutions in Turkey
limitations: This is an EXCLUSION. Storing it alongside positive requirements without an is_exclusion marker would invert its meaning - a student matching this text is disqualified, not qualified.
researcher_notes: A foreign-curriculum school PHYSICALLY IN Türkiye does not confer international eligibility on a Turkish citizen. This is exactly the case a student would most plausibly get wrong about themselves. Listed under the CANNOT APPLY conditions.

limitations: Explicit negative: recorded so a later pass knows precisely which sections are outstanding and does not re-research section 1.
researcher_notes: Sections 2 ADMISSION, 3 QUOTAS, 4 ASSESSMENT OF THE RESULTS, 5 SCHOLARSHIP, 6 APPLICATION SYSTEM and 7 REGISTRATION are Bootstrap accordions that did not expand under scripted clicks within the session's time budget. Section 2 in particular is expected to carry accepted exams and minimum scores - the Sabancı equivalent of Koç's per-college SAT table - and remains UNRETRIEVED.
